description:
Hidden Gem 2-Bedroom Apartment with Skylights & Stunning Views

Available September 1
Don't miss this unique top-floor 2-bedroom apartment located on the 3rd floor at 7 Adams Street in Somerville. This bright and inviting home features multiple beautiful skylights throughout the apartment, filling the space with natural light. With approximately 850 square feet, hardwood floors, in-unit laundry, and a private balcony overlooking downtown Somerville and Boston, this apartment truly must be seen to be appreciated.
Apartment Features:
 	2 bedrooms 
 	1 bathroom 
 	Approximately 850 square feet 
 	Top-floor (3rd floor) unit 
 	Multiple skylights throughout the home 
 	Heat and hot water included 
 	Hardwood floors 
 	In-unit laundry 
 	Spacious kitchen with: 
o	Gas stove 
o	Dishwasher 
o	Whole-house fan 
o	Plenty of cabinet space 
o	Comfortable sitting area 
 	Living room and dining area 
 	Insulating shades on skylights and balcony doors 
 	Access to attic storage 
 	Lead-safe property 
 	Some furnishings available if desired 
Outdoor Features:
 	Private balcony with gorgeous views of downtown and Somerville 
 	Large shared backyard 
 	Shared porch area 
 	Quiet, friendly neighborhood 
Tenant Pays:
 	Electricity 
 	Small gas bill for cooking stove 
 	Internet and cable services 
Pet Policy:
 	Cats okay 
Outstanding Location:
 	Approximately 5-minute walk to Magoun Square 
 	Approximately 5 minutes to the community bike path 
 	Short walk to the Lowell Street Green Line station 
 	Easy access to Boston and major commuting routes 
 	Quiet neighborhood with great neighbors 
Move-In Costs:
 	First month's rent 
 	Last month's rent 
 	Security deposit 
Available September 1.
This one-of-a-kind apartment offers charm, natural light, excellent storage, and an unbeatable Somerville location. The skylights, views, and outdoor spaces make this home truly special.

Must see to appreciate!
Please call or text me to schedule an appointment!!

Building heat is included, water is by Owner. Renter would pay electric and gas bill for stove. Deposits would be 1st month, last month and security deposit. Lease would be for one year!
